name: Operation DRBControl
description: Operation DRBControl is a high‑sophistication cyber‑espionage actor that uses a shared toolbox with groups such as Iron Tiger/APT27 and Winnti to conduct credential theft, data exfiltration, and ransomware delivery against government, critical infrastructure, and commercial targets in the United States, China, and Taiwan. The campaign relies on evolving backdoors (SysUpdate, HyperBro) that support both Windows and Linux, and it routinely leverages publicly known CVEs, DLL side‑loading abuses, and stolen certificates to evade defenses.
